registration_status: Committed before leakage-aware optimization on held-out folds 10/11
hypothesis: For fixed R32 ToyLoop weights, a rank-8 task-informed orthogonal observation can be optimized to lower held-out dark-to-observed Jacobian leakage while limiting held-out task error
source: NRF-09 six seeds R32 and R16 at 32 optimizer updates; model weights frozen with SHA-256 verified against source archive
fixed: All source model weights; decoder basis and ridge head may change, no neural training

arms.supervised: NRF-09 supervised cross-covariance rank8 baseline, fitted on fold1
arms.task_only: Same initial basis as supervised, optimize train fold1 ridge-reconstructed task MSE with 80 Adam updates
arms.joint: Same initial basis, optimize train task MSE plus gamma*(mean of per-calibration-state squared local Jacobian cross-fiber leakage) with 80 Adam updates; select gamma on calibration fold9
arms.random: Eight original Gaussian null subspaces with paired seeds 400000+31*i+17*task_seed; median of complete arm J=E+(mean leakage)^2

optimization.backend: CPU PyTorch double precision with QR/Stiefel representation of orthogonal 128x8 projection
optimization.candidate_selection: On calibration fold9, choose lowest J=task_MSE+mean_leakage² among gamma candidates satisfying task_MSE<=1.10*baseline supervised calibration MSE; if none passes select minimum task_MSE candidate; tie by smaller gamma
optimization.no_reruns: No changes to penalty grid, training steps, eligibility rule or seeds after seeing heldout

measurement.heldout_task_mse: Mean squared output error after ridge fitting train fold1 and evaluating fold10
measurement.heldout_leakage: Average over 12 shadow states of sqrt(||Uᵀ J_suffix(I-UUᵀ)||_F²/8), squared only in objective
measurement.contrast: joint arm compared to supervised baseline, task-only, and median of eight complete random control J

per_seed_conditions: joint heldout J < min(supervised heldout J,median(random arm J))

secondary: Report task-only outcome to distinguish extra supervised optimization from explicit penalty
Report all gamma selections and full numerical task/leakage/score pairs
Compute projector distance and exact calibration-vs-heldout leakage deviations
Report rank/orthogonality checks and control comparator
Report whether the joint arm Pareto-dominates any control in MSE/leakage separately
design_bounds: One synthetic recurrent family and previously chosen evaluation weight lambda1; statistical independence only across seeds; no guarantee for real LLMs, Lean reasoning or global observable quotient
resources: Local CPU only, no spending, 1-2 threads; no change to source checkpoint files
provenance: Commit preregistration before any novel heldout fold10/11 experiment, report positive and negative results in one PR
